options.blogdescription: Standalone directory and place listings engine

steps.code:
<?php
if (post_type_exists('aw_listing')) {
  $post_id = wp_insert_post([
    'post_title' => 'Sample Community Veterinary Clinic',
    'post_content' => 'Full-service veterinary and animal emergency care.',
    'post_status' => 'publish',
    'post_type' => 'aw_listing',
  ]);
  if ($post_id && !is_wp_error($post_id)) {
    update_post_meta($post_id, 'aw_verified', '1');
    update_post_meta($post_id, 'aw_district', 'North Sector');
  }
}
